role: post-hoc development audit on already inspected depth offsets; no independent test or localization claim
pick_rule: 5% of each trace peak for 3 consecutive samples, FD stations with peak >= 1% of FD global peak and FD pick <= 1.85 s; counts before origin minus 0.10 s expose noncausal background
limits: same two training anchors and already inspected FD development offsets; 80 m FMM grid, receiver snapping, receiver-only training, no PDE loss and no continuous FMM gradient; threshold picks are not physical first-arrival validation
